_comment: Simulator <-> real-game card mapping. Generated by perception/tools/gen_card_map.py; hand-authored fields are preserved on regeneration. sim_id null means the card exists in the real game but not in this simulator -- placements of it are reported and NOT injected. See the tool's docstring.

_schema.real_name: display name as it appears in the real game
_schema.sim_id: CardRegistry id, or null if unimplemented
_schema.sim_evo_id: CardRegistry id of the Evolution variant, or null
_schema.real_verified: a human confirmed this card exists in the recorded build
_schema.real_only: hand-added: exists in the real game, absent from the sim
_schema.aliases: alternative spellings the detector may emit
_schema.needs_review: generator could not fully determine this row
